_comment: Things set by hand, by fingerprint (imagetomodel room writes each thing's in NAME-labels.json). profile: [kind, rows] up from the thing's foot, kind up (standing) or back (lying), 'rest' the rows left; profiles: one per range of columns from its box's left edge; recess: rows and columns from its box's corner set 'depth' cubes in; raise: pixels of these colours (within rows) a cube proud; drop: pixels that aren't the thing's; shape: box, round, slab, escalator; front: its front's rows; back_to_wall.
